identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Of Comparing SAF-189s With Crizotinib In First Line ALK-Positive Advanced and Metastatic NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Multicenter, Phase III Open-label Study: Efficacy and Safety of Comparing SAF-189s With Crizotinib in First-line Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase-positive Advanced and Metastatic NSCLC

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical Industrial Development Co. Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This randomized, multicenter, Phase III, open-label study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of SAF-189s versus crizotinib treatment in participants with treatment-naive ALK-positive advanced NSCLC. Participants will be randomized 1:1 into one of the two treatment groups to receive either SAF-189s (160 milligrams \[mg\] once daily \[QD\]) or crizotinib (250 mg BID) orally, respectively.

armGroups.label: Foritinib Succinate
armGroups.description:
Foritinib Succinate capsules will be administered orally at a dose of 160 mg QD until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity withdrawal of consent, or death.

Other Names: SAF-189s

armGroups.label: Control: Crizotinib
armGroups.description: Crizotinib capsules will be administered orally at a dose of 250 mg BID until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity withdrawal of consent, or death.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Health-Related Quality of Life (HRQoL) by EORTC Quality of Life Questionnaire C30 Score
primaryOutcomes.description: All of the scales and single-item measures range in score from 0 to 100. A high scale score represents a better level in functional scales/items and Global health status, or worse level in symptom scales/items.
